panels.title: Return over range — selected accounts
panels.description: Monthly returns chained together. Each month = change in investment value / (beginning value + half of net deposits), so deposits and withdrawals do not count as gains.

targets.queryText:
SELECT EXP(SUM(LN(1 + r))) - 1 AS value FROM (
  SELECT SUM(change_in_investment_value) / SUM(beginning_value + 0.5 * net_flow) AS r
  FROM account_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY ts)
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT EXP(SUM(LN(1 + r))) - 1 AS value FROM (

  FROM account_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY ts)

panels.title: Benchmarks over the same months
panels.description: Total return (dividends reinvested) of each selected benchmark fund between the same dates.

targets.queryText:
WITH a AS (SELECT MIN(begin_ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1 FROM account_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000),
s AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol, name FROM benchmark_prices WHERE name IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.name, (SELECT adj_close FROM benchmark_prices x WHERE x.symbol = s.symbol AND x.ts <= a.t1 ORDER BY x.ts DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT adj_close FROM benchmark_prices x WHERE x.symbol = s.symbol AND x.ts <= a.t0 ORDER BY x.ts DESC LIMIT 1) - 1 AS value FROM s, a
targets.rawQueryText:

panels.title: Gain vs benchmarks — whole accounts (uses the Account and Benchmark selectors)
Cumulative return: my accounts vs benchmarks
panels.description: Everything starts at 0% on the day before the first statement in range. Portfolio return is flow-adjusted (deposits are not gains) and includes dividends/interest; benchmarks are total return, sampled on statement dates.

targets.queryText:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ts, MIN(begin_ts) AS b,
         SUM(change_in_investment_value) / SUM(beginning_value + 0.5 * net_flow) AS r
  FROM account_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY ts)
SELECT MIN(b) AS time, 'My portfolio' AS metric, 0.0 AS value FROM p HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT ts, 'My portfolio', EXP(SUM(LN(1 + r)) OVER (ORDER BY ts)) - 1 FROM p
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts, 'My portfolio', EXP(SUM(LN(1 + r)) OVER (ORDER BY ts)) - 1 FROM p
ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText:
WITH a AS (SELECT MIN(begin_ts) AS t0 FROM account_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000),
pts AS (SELECT t0 AS ts FROM a WHERE t0 IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT ts FROM account_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000),
s AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol, name FROM benchmark_prices WHERE name IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}))
SELECT pts.ts AS time, s.name AS metric,
       (SELECT adj_close FROM benchmark_prices x WHERE x.symbol = s.symbol AND x.ts <= pts.ts ORDER BY x.ts DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT adj_close FROM benchmark_prices x WHERE x.symbol = s.symbol AND x.ts <= a.t0 ORDER BY x.ts DESC LIMIT 1) - 1 AS value
FROM pts, s, a ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gain vs benchmarks — selected holdings (uses all selectors; needs 2+ statements)
Cumulative price return: selected holdings as a basket vs benchmarks
panels.description: Tick / untick holdings in the Holding selector to see how the basket would have done. Month-to-month price change of each position, weighted by its value at the previous statement. Price only: dividends and interest paid out are not included, so this slightly understates income-heavy holdings versus the total-return benchmarks.

targets.queryText:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ts, MIN(begin_ts) AS b, SUM(price_gain) / SUM(prev_value) AS r
  FROM holding_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND asset_class IN (${asset_class:sqlstring}) AND holding IN (${holding:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY ts HAVING SUM(prev_value) > 0)
SELECT MIN(b) AS time, 'Selected holdings' AS metric, 0.0 AS value FROM p HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT ts, 'Selected holdings', EXP(SUM(LN(1 + r)) OVER (ORDER BY ts)) - 1 FROM p
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cumulative price return: each selected holding

targets.queryText:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ts, holding, SUM(price_gain) / SUM(prev_value) AS r
  FROM holding_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND asset_class IN (${asset_class:sqlstring}) AND holding IN (${holding:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY ts, holding HAVING SUM(prev_value) > 0)
SELECT (SELECT MIN(begin_ts) FROM holding_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND asset_class IN (${asset_class:sqlstring}) AND holding IN (${holding:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000) AS time, holding AS metric, 0.0 AS value
FROM p GROUP BY holding
UNION ALL
SELECT ts, holding, EXP(SUM(LN(MAX(1 + r, 0.0001))) OVER (PARTITION BY holding ORDER BY ts)) - 1
FROM p ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ts, holding, SUM(price_gain) / SUM(prev_value) AS r
  FROM holding_periods WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND asset_class IN (${asset_class:sqlstring}) AND holding IN (${holding:sqlstring}) AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY ts, holding HAVING SUM(prev_value) > 0)

FROM p GROUP BY holding
UNION ALL

panels.title: Holdings detail — latest statement in range

targets.queryText:
SELECT h.account AS Account, h.asset_class AS "Asset class", h.holding AS Holding,
       h.quantity AS Quantity, h.price AS Price, h.market_value AS "Market value",
       h.market_value / (SELECT SUM(market_value) FROM holdings WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND asset_class IN (${asset_class:sqlstring}) AND holding IN (${holding:sqlstring}) AND ts = (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM holdings WHERE ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000) AND market_value > 0) AS Weight,
       h.cost_basis AS "Cost basis", h.unrealized_gain AS "Unrealized gain",
       CASE WHEN h.cost_basis > 0 THEN h.unrealized_gain / h.cost_basis END AS "Unrealized %",
       (SELECT hp.price_gain / hp.prev_value FROM holding_periods hp
         WHERE hp.ts = h.ts AND hp.account = h.account AND hp.security_id = h.security_id) AS "Price change (period)"
FROM holdings h WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND asset_class IN (${asset_class:sqlstring}) AND holding IN (${holding:sqlstring}) AND ts = (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM holdings WHERE ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000) ORDER BY h.market_value DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT h.account AS Account, h.asset_class AS "Asset class", h.holding AS Holding,
       h.quantity AS Quantity, h.price AS Price, h.market_value AS "Market value",
       h.market_value / (SELECT SUM(market_value) FROM holdings WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND asset_class IN (${asset_class:sqlstring}) AND holding IN (${holding:sqlstring}) AND ts = (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM holdings WHERE ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000) AND market_value > 0) AS Weight,
       h.cost_basis AS "Cost basis", h.unrealized_gain AS "Unrealized gain",
       CASE WHEN h.cost_basis > 0 THEN h.unrealized_gain / h.cost_basis END AS "Unrealized %",
       (SELECT hp.price_gain / hp.prev_value FROM holding_periods hp
         WHERE hp.ts = h.ts AND hp.account = h.account AND hp.security_id = h.security_id) AS "Price change (period)"
FROM holdings h WHERE account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND asset_class IN (${asset_class:sqlstring}) AND holding IN (${holding:sqlstring}) AND ts = (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM holdings WHERE ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts <= $__to / 1000) ORDER BY h.market_value DESC
